planets.name: K2-155 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-155 with a 40.7-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-155 d was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-155. Its orbit and size follow Díez Alonso et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: K2-155d
quotes.card: K2-155d is a potentially habitable Super-Earth exoplanet in the K2-155 system.
quotes.introduction: It is the outermost of three known planets orbiting around the K-type star K2-155 in the constellation Taurus, approximately 290 light-years from Earth.
